segments.snp4.14:1.1: “Pucchāmi taṃ ādiccabandhu [ādiccabandhuṃ (sī. syā.)], vivekaṃ santipadañca mahesi;
segments.snp4.14:1.3: Kathaṃ disvā nibbāti bhikkhu, anupādiyāno lokasmiṃ kiñci”.
segments.snp4.14:3.3: Na tena thāmaṃ [mānaṃ (sī. ka.)] kubbetha, na hi sā nibbuti sataṃ vuttā.
segments.snp4.14:4.1: “Seyyo na tena maññeyya, nīceyyo athavāpi sarikkho;
segments.snp4.14:4.3: Phuṭṭho [puṭṭho (sī. syā. ka.)] anekarūpehi, nātumānaṃ vikappayaṃ tiṭṭhe.
segments.snp4.14:5.3: Ajjhattaṃ upasantassa, natthi attā kuto nirattā vā.
segments.snp4.14:6.1: “Majjhe yathā samuddassa, ūmi no jāyatī ṭhito hoti;
segments.snp4.14:6.3: Evaṃ ṭhito anejassa, ussadaṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñci”.
segments.snp4.14:7.3: Paṭipadaṃ vadehi bhaddante, pātimokkhaṃ athavāpi samādhiṃ”.
segments.snp4.14:8.3: Rase ca nānugijjheyya, na ca mamāyetha kiñci lokasmiṃ.
segments.snp4.14:9.1: “Phassena yadā phuṭṭhassa, paridevaṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñcñcci;
segments.snp4.14:9.3: Bhavañca nābhijappeyya, bheravesu ca na sampavedheyya.
segments.snp4.14:10.3: Laddhā na sannidhiṃ kayirā, na ca parittase tāni alabhamāno.
segments.snp4.14:12.3: Tandiṃ māyaṃ hassaṃ khiḍḍaṃ, methunaṃ vippajahe savibhūsaṃ.
segments.snp4.14:13.1: “Āthabbaṇaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ, no vidahe athopi nakkhattaṃ;
segments.snp4.14:13.3: Virutañca gabbhakaraṇaṃ, tikicchaṃ māmako na seveyya.
segments.snp4.14:14.3: Lobhaṃ saha macchariyena, kodhaṃ pesuṇiyañca panudeyya.
segments.snp4.14:15.1: “Kayavikkaye na tiṭṭheyya, upavādaṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñci;
segments.snp4.14:15.3: Gāme ca nābhisajjeyya, lābhakamyā janaṃ na lapayeyya.
segments.snp4.14:16.1: “Na ca katthitā siyā bhikkhu, na ca vācaṃ payuttaṃ bhāseyya;
segments.snp4.14:16.3: Pāgabbhiyaṃ na sikkheyya, kathaṃ viggāhikaṃ na kathayeyya.
segments.snp4.14:17.1: “Mosavajje na nīyetha, sampajāno saṭhāni na kayirā;
segments.snp4.14:18.1: “Sutvā rusito bahuṃ vācaṃ, samaṇānaṃ vā puthujanānaṃ [puthuvacanānaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.snp4.14:18.3: Pharusena ne na paṭivajjā, na hi santo paṭisenikaronti.
segments.snp4.14:19.1: “Etañca dhammamaññāya, vicinaṃ bhikkhu sadā sato sikkhe;
segments.snp4.14:19.3: Santīti nibbutiṃ ñatvā, sāsane gotamassa na pamajjeyya.
segments.snp4.14:20.3: Tasmā hi tassa bhagavato sāsane, appamatto sadā namassamanusikkhe”ti.

lines: 929-30. Athassa bhagavā yasmā indriyasaṃvaro sīlassa rakkhā, yasmā vā iminā anukkamena desiyamānā ayaṃ desanā tāsaṃ devatānaṃ sappāyā, tasmā indriyasaṃvarato pabhuti paṭipadaṃ dassento “cakkhūhī”tiādimāraddho.
Tattha cakkhūhi neva lolassāti adiṭṭhadakkhitabbādivasena cakkhūhi lolo nevassa.
Bhavañca nābhijappeyyāti tassa phassassa vinodanatthāya kāmabhavādibhavañca na pattheyya.
Bheravesu ca na sampavedheyyāti tassa phassassa paccayabhūtesu sīhabyagghādīsu bheravesu ca na sampavedheyya, avasesesu vā ghānindriyamanindriyavisayesu nappavedheyya.
Purimehi vā indriyasaṃvaraṃ dassetvā iminā “araññe vasatā bheravaṃ disvā vā sutvā vā na vedhitabban”ti dasseti.
Laddhā na sannidhiṃ kayirāti etesaṃ annādīnaṃ yaṃkiñci dhammena labhitvā “araññe ca senāsane vasatā sadā dullabhan”ti cintetvā sannidhiṃ na kareyya.
Jhāyī na pādalolassāti jhānābhirato ca na pādalolo assa.
Tandiṃ māyaṃ hassaṃ khiḍḍanti ālasiyañca māyañca hassañca kāyikacetasikakhiḍḍañca.
Kayavikkayeti pañcahi sahadhammikehi saddhiṃ vañcanāvasena vā udayapatthanāvasena vā na tiṭṭheyya.
Upavādaṃ bhikkhu na kareyyāti upavādakare kilese anibbattento attani parehi samaṇabrāhmaṇehi upavādaṃ na janeyya.
Gāme ca nābhisajjeyyāti gāme ca gihisaṃsaggādīhi nābhisajjeyya.
Lābhakamyā janaṃ na lapayeyyāti lābhakāmatāya janaṃ nālapayeyya.
Sutvā rusito bahuṃ vācaṃ, samaṇānaṃ vā puthujanānanti rusito ghaṭṭito parehi tesa samaṇānaṃ vā khattiyādibhedānaṃ vā aññesaṃ puthujanānaṃ bahumpi aniṭṭhavācaṃ sutvā.
